name: Guardian Realms TCG
storyline: In the fractured world of Guardian Realms, powerful factions vie for control as ancient forces stir beneath the surface. The mighty Rythguard Empire faces rebellion from the Carrowlands, while mystical beings and hidden realms influence the balance of power. Players take on the role of leaders commanding legendary Guardians, wielding spells, relics, and warriors to defend their Stronghold and shape the fate of the Realms. As conflict spreads across three strategic battle lanes, every choice brings the world closer to unity... or ruin.
summary: Guardian Realms TCG is a cross-platform, fantasy-themed trading card game set in a realm of shifting alliances, rebellion, and magic. Players command powerful Guardians, along with Equipment, Effect, and Field Cards, to battle across three strategic lanes with the goal of destroying their opponent’s Stronghold. By defeating Outposts, players can disable lanes and control the flow of battle, adding layers of tactical depth.
